item.title: Gold prices climb to a record as the dollar slips
item.dc:creator: Desk
item.description:
Spot gold rose 1.2% to a record as the dollar index fell for a third day and traders priced in rate cuts. Analysts said central bank buying remained strong through the quarter, with China and India among the largest buyers, and that physical demand in Asia had picked up after the festival season discounts began in earnest across major markets …
